node.statement: Differentiating the exact quadratic equation gives ||DG(T)||<=(1+epsilon_r)||Z_T||*(1+||DG(T)||). For ||T||<=2r, ||Z_T||<=(1+d)||T||<=3r. Hence a universal cutoff epsilon_r+r<=b_g makes 3(1+epsilon_r)r<=1/2, allows absorption, and yields ||DG(T)||<=K_g*r for a universal K_g depending only on the fixed C_g,k_g.
